motive.canonical: Clara had discovered that Owen held a fraudulent mortgage over her cafe building and flat. She was going to report it to the committee. Owen killed her to prevent this.

method.canonical: Strangulation with a leather belt in the rear alley. The fire was set afterwards to destroy evidence.

opportunity.canonical: Owen arranged the meeting and was seen entering the alley at 07:00. His alibi — supplied by employee Col Hartley — is fabricated. Ash on his boots places him at the scene.

explanation: Correct. Owen Price killed Clara Wells. Clara had discovered that Owen held a fraudulent mortgage on her cafe building — a charge forged in Marcus Bell's name as security for Owen's debt. She called Owen at 06:20 and arranged a meeting in the rear alley. Owen arrived at 07:00, was seen entering the alley by Nadia, and strangled Clara with his belt when she refused to hand over the documents. He set a fire with lighter fluid to destroy the evidence and conceal cause of death — the damp morning air defeated him. The belt — with his initials on the keeper loop — was found behind the bins. His alibi, provided by employee Col Hartley, was arranged the night before and collapses when Col is pressed: he wasn't there until 07:30. Ash from the alley fire was still on Owen's boot soles when examined.
